title: Ankerstein stone catalog (ankerstein-shapes.json)
description: The real Ankerstein 'part library' layer, hand-authored (not fetched — no open parts library exists for Ankerstein the way LDraw exists for Lego, see docs/ANKERSTEIN-ENGINE.md §1). One entry per distinct real stone shape/mold, independent of any set — a set's own composition lives in ankerstein-sets.schema.json instead. Every entry's sourceCitation is mandatory: the concrete mechanism keeping this catalog honest to the project's 'real data only' rule (see docs/agents/working-mode.md).

shapeType.description: Real shape family, matching the historical set-supplement vocabulary (see docs/ANKERSTEIN-ENGINE.md §2/§3).

dimensionsMm.description: [width, height, depth] in millimeters, in the shape's own local frame.

caliber.description: Großes Kaliber (25mm base cube) or Kleines Kaliber (20mm base cube) — separate, non-interchangeable grids, never mixed within one real historical set.

sourceCitation.description: Mandatory: where this shape's real dimensions were sourced from (a publication, a page, or a direct real-world measurement with who/when). Never a placeholder.
